# Community Rule Column 6 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 6 | **Condition:** complete

---

**6:1** Furthermore, no one shall bring a charge against his neighbor before the Assembly without first having reproved him before witnesses.

**6:2** In these ways they shall conduct themselves in all their places of residence. Whenever members are found together, the junior shall defer to the senior in work and in property.

**6:3** Together they shall eat, together they shall bless, and together they shall take counsel. In every place where there are ten men of

**6:4** the council of the community, a priest shall not be absent from them. Each shall sit according to his rank before the priest, and in this order

**6:5** they shall be consulted regarding every matter. When they set the table to eat, or prepare the new wine

**6:6** to drink, the priest shall extend his hand first to pronounce the blessing over the first portion of the bread and the new wine.

**6:7** And in the place where the ten are, there shall not be absent a man who studies the Torah day

**6:8** and night, continually, each one relieving another. The Assembly shall keep watch together for a third of every night of

**6:9** the year, to read the Book, to study the Law, and to bless together.

**6:10** This is the rule for the session of the Assembly. Each in his designated place: first the priests, then the elders, then all

**6:11** the rest of the people, each in his assigned place. In the same order they shall be consulted regarding every judgment, every counsel, and every matter

**6:12** that comes before the Assembly, so that each may offer his knowledge to the council of the community.

**6:13** No one shall interrupt the speech of his neighbor before his brother has finished speaking. Nor shall anyone speak

**6:14** out of turn before the one whose rank is inscribed ahead of his. The one who is called upon shall speak in his turn. In the session of

**6:15** the Assembly, no one shall speak any word without the permission of the Assembly. And if

**6:16** the man who serves as the Instructor over the Assembly — if anyone has something to say to the Assembly

**6:17** but does not hold the position of the one who consults the council of the community, that person shall stand on his feet

**6:18** and say: "I have something to say to the Assembly." If they grant him leave, he shall speak.

**6:19** Any man of Israel who volunteers to join the council of the community:

**6:20** the Instructor who is at the head of the Assembly shall examine him regarding his understanding and his deeds. If he is suited for the discipline,

**6:21** he shall admit him into the covenant to return to the truth and to turn away from all injustice. He shall instruct him in all the ordinances of the community.

**6:22** Afterward, when he comes to stand before the Assembly, all members shall be consulted regarding his case.

**6:23** As the lot determines by the decision of the Assembly, he shall either draw near or withdraw. When he draws near to the council of the community,

**6:24** he shall not touch the pure food of the Assembly until they have examined his spirit and his deeds, and not until he has completed one full year.

**6:25** Nor shall he share in the communal property of the Assembly.

**6:26** When he has completed one year within the community, the Assembly shall deliberate regarding his case — his understanding and his deeds in Torah. If the lot falls to him to advance into the council of the community, by the authority of the priests and the majority of the men of the covenant,

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering adjudicated from EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic). "Assembly" adopted as compromise rendering for ha-rabbim (the Many), balancing EMET's "the Many," LOGOS's "Congregation," and PNEUMA's "full assembly." "Instructor" for mebaqqer preferred over PNEUMA's "Guardian." "Pure food" clarifies tohorat. "New wine" for tirosh preserved. See disagreement log for all divergences.*
